verdict.rationale: Whether a state business-filing portal publishes its operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts before a founder starts is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes. Those probes show the SCC site and the Clerk's Information System disallow all crawling, so nothing was fetched and nothing documents published operating hours, per-day limits, or session-timeout disclosures. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
